too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
too_frequent: You're syncing too often. Wait a few minutes.
already_running: A sync is already running. Check back in a few minutes.
platform_sync_failed: Syncing with {{platform}} failed. Please try again.
revoked_edinio: Access to Edinio was revoked. Reconnect the store.
revoked_woocommerce: WooCommerce no longer accepts the API key. Make a new key (Read) and connect it to the same address: the store’s history stays.
revoked_shopify: Shopify no longer gives the Hontrio app access (was it uninstalled?). Reconnect the store.
store_not_yours: This store isn't in your account.
platform_unsupported: This store's platform isn't supported yet.
store_read_failed: We couldn't load the store. Please try again.
products_read_failed: We couldn't load the products. Please try again.
store_save_failed: We couldn't save the store. Please try again.
store_reconnect_failed: We couldn't reconnect the store. Please try again.
store_delete_failed: We couldn't disconnect the store. Please try again.
store_taken: This store is already connected to another Hontrio account.
store_url_invalid: The store address isn't valid. Example: https://your-store.com
store_no_response_check_url: The store isn't responding. Check the address.
store_responded_status: The store responded with error {{status}}. Please try again.
encryption_failed: We couldn't store the access details securely. Please contact support.
server_not_configured: This connection isn't set up on the server. Please contact support.
connect_session_expired: The connection session expired. Please try again.
woo_consumer_key_invalid: Invalid Consumer Key: it must start with ck_.
woo_consumer_secret_invalid: Invalid Consumer Secret: it must start with cs_.
woo_key_not_accepted: The API key wasn't accepted. Check the key, the secret and the permission (Read).
woo_key_no_orders: The key can't read orders. Create a key with the Read permission (Hontrio changes nothing in your store).
woo_not_detected: This address doesn't look like a WooCommerce store with the REST API enabled.
shopify_shop_missing: The Shopify store address is missing. Example: ?shop=your-store.myshopify.com
shopify_shop_invalid: The Shopify store address must look like this: your-store.myshopify.com
shopify_callback_invalid: Shopify's response is missing some details. Start connecting again.
shopify_signature_invalid: Shopify's signature isn't valid. Start connecting again.
shopify_token_failed: Shopify didn't grant access to the store. Please try again.
offers_invalid: Choose at least one offer and at most {{max}}.
google_accounts_failed: We couldn't load your Google Ads accounts. Please try again.
google_disconnect_failed: We couldn't disconnect your Google account. Please try again.
customer_id_invalid: The Google Ads account ID isn't valid.
ads_account_manager: A manager account can't run campaigns. Choose an advertiser account.
ads_account_save_failed: We couldn't save the selected account. Please try again.
failed_internal: The sync failed because of a problem on our side. We'll try again automatically.
shopify_data_request_title: A customer asked for their data (Shopify)
shopify_data_request_body: Shopify forwarded a customer's request for their data. Of the requested orders, Hontrio has {{orders}}: only the amounts, products, date, country and campaign source, without name, email, phone or address. You can download them from Settings → Data export.
deadline_reached: The sync didn't finish in the time allowed; it will continue on the next run.
woo_no_response: The store didn't respond. Check that the site is online.
woo_key_rejected: WooCommerce no longer accepts the API key.
woo_key_no_read: The API key doesn't have read access in WooCommerce.
woo_blocked: The store blocked Hontrio's requests (403). Check the site's security settings (firewall, Cloudflare).
shopify_no_response: Shopify didn't respond. We'll try again at the next sync.
shopify_access_revoked: Shopify no longer accepts the Hontrio app's access (was it uninstalled?).
shopify_access_denied: Shopify doesn't give the app access to this data: {{detail}}
shopify_store_closed: The Shopify store is closed or locked (error {{status}}).
shopify_not_found: The Shopify store no longer exists (404).
shopify_too_expensive: Shopify rejected the request: it exceeds the API limit.
shopify_uninstalled: The Hontrio app was uninstalled from Shopify.
edinio_no_response: Edinio didn't respond. We'll try again at the next sync.
edinio_rate_limited: Edinio received too many requests. We'll try again at the next sync.
edinio_not_configured: The Edinio connection isn't set up on the server.
google_access_revoked: Google access was revoked or has expired.
google_accounts_partial: We couldn't read some Google Ads accounts ({{code}}): {{detail}}
store_url_local: Local addresses (localhost, .local) can't be connected. Use the store's public address.
store_url_private_ip: Private network addresses can't be connected. Use the store's public address.
store_url_credentials: The address must not contain a username or password.
store_url_domain: The domain isn't valid. Example: your-store.com
store_url_port: Use the store's normal address, without a port (or with port 443 or 8443).
store_redirects: The store redirects to {{url}}. Enter that address instead.
store_redirect_loop: The store keeps redirecting to other pages. Check the address.
apply_campaign_missing: The campaign no longer exists in Hontrio or in Google Ads.
apply_no_account: The store has no Google Ads account chosen.
autopilot_google_error: The autopilot couldn't read the Google Ads account ({{code}}): {{detail}}
google_audit_failed: The Google Ads account couldn't be read ({{code}}). {{detail}}
launch_already_active: The store already has a Hontrio campaign. You can pause or resume it in Campaigns.
launch_audit_missing: Check the Google Ads account first (the audit).
launch_blocked: There are still steps to do before the launch.
launch_eu_confirm: Confirm the EU declaration for the existing campaigns.
launch_geo_unknown: We couldn't find the campaign's country ({{country}}) among Google's targets.
launch_labels_failed: We couldn't add the Hontrio label in Merchant Center.
launch_no_campaign: Google didn't return the created campaign. Check in Google Ads before trying again.
launch_no_merchant: We don't know the store's Merchant Center account. Choose it in Settings.
launch_overlap_choice: Choose what we do with the existing campaigns on the same products.
launch_pause_existing_failed: The Hontrio campaign started, but the existing campaigns couldn't be paused: {{detail}}
launch_save_failed: The campaign was created in Google Ads (ID {{campaign}}) but couldn't be saved in Hontrio. Contact support.
merchant_google_missing: The Google account isn't connected: Hontrio can't read Merchant Center.
merchant_denied: The connected Google account has no access to Merchant Center {{merchant}}. Use the Google account that manages Merchant Center. ({{detail}})
merchant_failed: Merchant Center didn't respond as expected ({{merchant}}): {{detail}}
group_missing: The campaign to launch wasn't found.
launch_group_blocked: The campaign still has steps to do before launch (see the summary).
launch_too_many_exclusions: The main Performance Max campaign would have to leave out {{count}} products, over the Google limit of 990. Put fewer products in your group campaigns.
apply_retired: This proposal no longer applies: Hontrio no longer changes the target or splits campaigns by margin.
launch_no_budget: Choose the campaign's daily budget first.
gomag_key_invalid: The Gomag API key doesn’t look right: copy it again, without spaces.
gomag_shop_or_key: Gomag doesn’t recognise the store or the key. Check the store address (the one in Gomag) and the API key.
gomag_key_rejected: Gomag no longer accepts the API key.
gomag_key_no_orders: The key can’t read orders. Give it read rights for orders in Gomag.
gomag_no_response: Gomag didn’t respond. We’ll try again at the next sync.
gomag_rate_limited: Gomag asked for a pause (too many requests). We’ll continue at the next sync.
merchantpro_credentials_invalid: Copy the API User and API Secret exactly, without spaces.
merchantpro_key_rejected: MerchantPro doesn’t accept the API User and API Secret. Check them in Settings → API and webhooks.
merchantpro_forbidden: MerchantPro refused access ({{detail}}). Check the API user’s rights: reading products and orders. After several wrong attempts, MerchantPro blocks requests for a few minutes.
merchantpro_key_no_orders: The API user can’t read orders. Give it read rights for orders in MerchantPro.
merchantpro_not_detected: The address doesn’t look like a MerchantPro store (the API doesn’t respond). Enter the store’s domain.
merchantpro_no_response: MerchantPro didn’t respond. We’ll try again at the next sync.
merchantpro_rate_limited: MerchantPro asked for a pause (request limit). We’ll continue at the next sync.
opencart_key_invalid: The Hontrio key has 48 characters (digits and letters a–f). Copy it from the extension’s page.
opencart_extension_missing: The Hontrio extension doesn’t answer at this address. Check the address (and the store’s folder) and that the Hontrio module is installed.
opencart_key_rejected: The Hontrio extension doesn’t accept the key. Copy it again from the extension’s page (a new key replaces the old one).
opencart_disabled: The Hontrio extension’s API is turned off. Turn it on from the extension’s page in OpenCart.
opencart_blocked: The store blocked Hontrio’s requests (error {{status}}). Check the site’s security settings (firewall, Cloudflare).
opencart_no_response: The OpenCart store didn’t respond. Check that the site is online.
opencart_unavailable: The OpenCart store is unavailable right now (error {{status}}).
opencart_rate_limited: The store asked for a pause (too many requests). We’ll continue at the next sync.
opencart_error: The Hontrio extension responded with an error: {{detail}}
revoked_gomag: Gomag no longer accepts the API key. Connect the store again with a new key (Settings → Integrations): its history stays.
revoked_merchantpro: MerchantPro no longer accepts the API user or doesn’t give it read rights. Fix it in MerchantPro and click Sync, or connect the store again with new details.
revoked_opencart: The Hontrio extension no longer accepts the key or its API is off. Fix it in OpenCart and click Sync, or connect the store again with the new key.
